name: Auto Filter Legacy
title: Filter choices and circuits
text: Live 11 predecessor only: The predecessor offers low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, notch and Morph, with 12/24 dB slopes. Clean and OSR are described for all types; MS2, SMP and PRD for low/high-pass. This establishes selections, not a transfer function or an internal circuit requirement. Target 12.4.3 Legacy applicability is U.

name: Auto Filter Legacy
title: Drive eligibility
text: Live 11 predecessor only: An additional Drive control precedes filtering for low-pass, high-pass or band-pass with a circuit other than Clean. Its numerical gain/distortion law is unspecified. Target 12.4.3 Legacy applicability is U.

name: Auto Filter Legacy
title: Frequency and resonance editing
text: Live 11 predecessor only: Frequency and Resonance are editable with knobs, their numeric displays and the X-Y display. No display-to-coefficient mapping is established. Target 12.4.3 Legacy applicability is U.

name: Auto Filter Legacy
title: Morph traversal and snapping
text: Live 11 predecessor only: Morph traverses low-pass, band-pass, high-pass, notch and back to low-pass; its knob context menu offers snaps to those four named types. Target 12.4.3 Legacy applicability is U.

name: Auto Filter Legacy
title: Envelope control
text: Live 11 predecessor only: Envelope Amount sets influence on frequency; Attack and Release control response to rising and falling signal level. The source gives relative fast/slow behavior, not an envelope formula. Target 12.4.3 Legacy applicability is U.

name: Auto Filter Legacy
title: External envelope trigger
text: Live 11 predecessor only: The unfolded Sidechain section can select another track as envelope trigger. Sidechain Gain affects trigger level, not source mix volume; Dry/Wet 100% uses the sidechain alone and 0% effectively bypasses it. The sidechain is described as a trigger, not audible signal admission. Target 12.4.3 Legacy applicability is U.

name: Auto Filter Legacy
title: LFO timing and stereo roles
text: Live 11 predecessor only: LFO Amount affects frequency and Rate supports Hz or tempo sync. Shapes include sine, square, triangle, rising/falling saw and mono/stereo sample-and-hold. Phase offsets equal-rate stereo LFOs; Spin detunes their rates. Phase/Spin have no stated sound effect for sample-and-hold; its two selections distinguish independent/shared channel modulation. No RNG distribution or phase law is established. Target 12.4.3 Legacy applicability is U.

name: Auto Filter Legacy
title: Quantize Beat
text: Live 11 predecessor only: With Quantize Beat off, frequency modulation follows its control source; on, changes occur rhythmically. Numbered values denote sixteenth notes, so value 4 denotes a quarter-note interval. Exact event rounding and clock phase are unspecified. Target 12.4.3 Legacy applicability is U.

name: Auto Filter Legacy
title: Older filter upgrade
text: Live 11 predecessor only: The Live 11 text describes pre-9.5 Sets opening its earlier filter subset without Drive and exposing an Upgrade button. Upgrade permanently changes that instance to the then-new models and may change sound. This is not evidence of a target 12.4.3 upgrade route. Target 12.4.3 Legacy applicability is U.

name: Frequency Shifter

text: Live 11 predecessor only: Shift moves incoming frequencies by an additive Hz amount through Coarse/Fine, rather than preserving harmonic ratios through pitch transposition. The documentary example maps a 440 Hz sine with +100 Hz shift to 540 Hz. No target tolerance, negative-frequency or aliasing rule follows. Target 12.4.3 Legacy applicability is U.

title: Ring mode
text: Live 11 predecessor only: Ring adds and subtracts the selected frequency; its 440 Hz input/100 Hz example names 340 and 540 Hz components. Relative amplitudes and implementation are unspecified. Target 12.4.3 Legacy applicability is U.

name: Frequency Shifter
